data.name: Super Hipster Lumberjack
data.detailed_description:
You can't beat this game!!! Super Hipster Lumberjack is a love letter to the era of difficult online flash platformers. This cheap double feature includes the original highschool project by Noah that released in 2015. Along with a remastered version of the game released in 2025.

In this story Noah attempts to make a game for the first time. He is then trapped in his own creation. He learns that making games is a lot harder than he thought. Use your axe to traverse a mess of your own mind's design! To beat this game you'll need precision platforming and experimention with jump techniques. Are you up to the task?

reviews.review: This is not the worst game ever made. Because this is not a game. It is a depraved and highly effective torture device, the likes of which could NEVER have been conjured by the creators of the brazen bull and the iron maiden working together. Adolf Eichman couldn't have DREAMED of creating something this deplorable, and if he did he would have hung himself in guilt. So I repeat, this is not the worst game ever made, it is however the single worst thing EVER created by humankind. For centuries we have wondered if humans are good or evil by nature. I still cannot answer this question. But after playing, if you could call this play, this thing, I have lost much of my faith in humanity. I hope, sincerely, that the devil crawled out of hell and whispered in the ear of Noah Lewin to give him the inspiration for such a thing. Because then, I would not have to face the possibility that human malice runs so deep as to conjure such an awful evil creation. The existence of super hipster lumberjack PROVES beyond a shadow of a doubt that humans will NEVER travel back in time. Because if that technology was EVER made, we would have gone back and prevented this abomination from entering the material plane. Do not buy this game. Do not support this developer, do not give him the resources to build more digital concentration camps. And please for the love of god do not play super hipster lumberjack. You will regret it. This game has sucked all the joy I once had out of my life. Everything is terrible now. I see only in shades of gray. I feel only sadness, anger, and regret. Life is pain and it is all because of super hipster lumberjack. I have NEVER hated something like I hate super hipster lumberjack. It has ruined my life to such a degree that I am considering ending it all after I get this message out. Do not play this game. I only played it for a 29 minutes, but those minutes felt like decades. They were the worst 29 minutes of my life and I hope to god that I can forget them someday. But hope is fragile, all because of super hipster lumberjack. The day this game was posted to steam was BY FAR the single worst day in human history. It DWARFS 9/11 in the enormity of its tragedy and the evil that surrounded it. There can be no peace, all because of super hipster lumberjack. The graphics are more hideous than the maw of death, fouler than the deepest crypt, and more maddening than the face of an elder god. The music, taunts you all the while. Horrendous 8 bit remakes of open source music. It will drive you to insanity. It made my ears bleed while my eyes bled from the burning imagery before me. The gameplay was curated to induce as much rage as humanly possible. There are 3 controls, left, right, and jump. And somehow those 3 controls have made me incapable of ever experiencing another ounce of joy. The gameplay felt like Noah looked up how to make a game in unity, watched a 5 minute video, and made it in 30 minutes. The only twist is that Satan himself told him to make it as painful as the darkest pit of hell. There is no artistry here. Super hipster lumber jack is the place creativity goes to die. It is the end of all things good and the gateway to all things evil. Stay far away from this game. Once you play it you can NEVER go back. Do not make the same mistake I did. And Noah, If you are reading this and IF you still have a single ounce of humanity left in you after what you've done, PLEASE remove this thing from steam. Do not allow more people to be dragged under and whisked away to a word of suffering. Do not allow another soul to feel the same pain I have. Because I would rather go through any of the layers of hell described in Dante's inferno than play this thing for another second.
